parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no members array, no structural_evidence fields (all null: differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, shared_field_count), and no context flags on any participating record. Without concrete field or method overlap data it is impossible to ground a protocol-inheritance or default-implementation recommendation in literal evidence from the cluster. The two protocols — AudioPlayerProtocol and TimeShiftablePlayer — may well have a meaningful subset relationship (the cluster_id signal suggests it), but the absence of any populated evidence fields means any recommendation would be speculative rather than grounded, violating the no-hallucination rule.
